profileDefinitions.name: PDF cold reader open
profileDefinitions.boundary: Reader instance creation through ready/error, including restoration. Cold means a new application reader instance, not cleared browser or OS caches. Saved-workspace restoration and five-minute expiry recreation use separate profiles.

profileDefinitions.name: PDF saved-workspace reader restore

profileDefinitions.name: PDF warm selection dispatch
